_comment: Standing preferences: the single source for every schedule, floor, threshold and option below. /hunt-onboard fills it; change it only on the user's word and record the decision in decisions.md.

schedule._why: Ticks run inside tick_start-tick_end on the listed weekdays (0 = Sunday). Questions are asked only inside ask_start-ask_end, because a pending question blocks every later wakeup. Caps reset at reset_hour in tz.

money._why: Optional. A hands-on role whose posted hourly rate tops out under ic_rate_floor is dropped; a full-time IC role whose posted pay tops out under ft_salary_floor is rejected, and one under ft_salary_target is flagged Below target. null turns a check off. These numbers never appear on the tracker.

recruiter_weights._why: Score weights for the recruiter-list lane (hunt-recruiter). They must sum to 100.

engagement._why: Which employment structures pass gate G1. Remove an entry to reject it.

location._why: remote_required: on-site or hybrid roles fail G2 unless they sit in one of onsite_metros (place-name regexes, e.g. \\bboston\\b).

cv._why: pages: exact page count every CV must render to. paper: letter or a4. min_coverage: an archetype CV is used as-is at or above this JD-term coverage. keep_margin: points a new archetype variant must gain to be kept.

tailoring._why: cv: per-job (a tailored CV for every application) or archetype. letter: per-job (/hunt-tailor picks the letter approach for each posting, A requirements map, B first two weeks, C three questions or D lean letter plus P.S., and says why) or a fixed A, B, C or D. review: bikeshed (each newly tailored CV and letter is published for the user to approve first) or auto (sent without review; a standing decision recorded in decisions.md). A B or C letter always waits for review.

exclusions._why: Excluded stacks, title words and companies live in config/prefilter.json (stack_title_drop, ic_title_drop, company_drop).

research._why: Company research for kits uses the harness's WebSearch and WebFetch. Optional extra tools (firecrawl, Perplexity) are used only when the harness has them.

voice._why: Extra words and phrases the tracker and drafts must never use, on top of the shipped list of marketing cliches.
